_comment: Optional --map file for: node scripts/importDataset.js --type students --file <csv> --map import-mappings/students.json
`columns` maps an exact CSV header (as it appears in your file) to a Student schema field, and takes precedence over the built-in header synonyms below.
`defaults` fills a field for every row whose CSV cell is blank; --department/--year/--semester/--academicYear CLI flags fill those same fields afterwards, for whatever is still blank.
Built-in header synonyms (case/spacing/punctuation-insensitive; see utils/importNormalizers.js HEADER_SYNONYMS.students) — no --map needed if your headers already match one of these:
regno, rollno, registernumber -> registerNumber (required, unique, upsert key)
dept, department -> department (required unless --department is passed)
sem, semester -> semester (required number, unless --semester is passed)
academicyear -> academicYear (required number, unless --academicYear is passed)
year -> year (study year 1-4, unless --year is passed)
section, division -> section (default "A" on insert; blank leaves the stored value untouched on update)
